paragraphs: Here's my big idea, friend. God cares about ordinary, everyday people showing up. This passage is a list of names and towns, and every single name matters. Nobody in it is filler, and nobody in it is forgotten.

Look at what the people did. After the wall was built, Jerusalem needed people in it (Nehemiah 7:1-4), and the people made room. Some were chosen by lots, and some stepped up on their own, and "the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem" (Nehemiah 11:2). The work was not finished when the wall went up, because somebody had to live there and stay.

So here's the question for you, baker. Where can you say yes today, even in a small way? You might not get a big moment, but God sees the faithful work of showing up, again and again. I know a little about being forgotten, and I promise you the One who made everything keeps the record. Jerusalem's story is NOT done, and yours isn't either.
